lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a durable object shell layer resolves an injected registry by key and guards a missing entry add an integration test with a registry missing that key to prove the guard actually runs a unit test on the pure resolver function alone does not exercise the shell s guard
lessons.text: When a Durable-Object shell layer resolves an injected registry by key and guards a missing entry, add an integration test with a registry missing that key to prove the guard actually runs — a unit test on the pure resolver function alone does not exercise the shell's guard.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a command s spec required outcome is broadcasting to every connected player add an integration test that sends the command over a live connection with a second connected client and asserts that client s projection updates a unit test that calls the projection function directly does not prove the broadcast path works
lessons.text: When a command's spec-required outcome is broadcasting to every connected player, add an integration test that sends the command over a live connection with a second connected client and asserts that client's projection updates — a unit test that calls the projection function directly does not prove the broadcast path works.
evidence: HUB-12 (spec.md P2 AC7) — no evidence in sala-do.integration.test.ts (server/core)
